outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone transparent-background UI reward plaque for Fall, a proprietary medieval Spanish-deck card game.
Create ONE isolated front-facing achievement plaque, intended to display about 320 pixels wide by 210 pixels tall in a game. Wide 3:2 landscape canvas, 1536 by 1024 preferred, transparent exterior. The plaque occupies nearly the whole canvas with a small clean transparent margin and a self-contained soft cast shadow. A broad sturdy silhouette with subtly clipped corners, dark cool charcoal and blue-gray slate/leather interior, an aged matte brass rim with restrained etched corner flourishes and a few rivets. Tiny original fan of three blank ivory playing cards at the top centre suggests a captured, cleared table; make it a modest crest, not a large illustration. No suit artwork copied from an existing deck. The inner writing area must be spacious, very dark, quiet and blank, occupying most of the plaque: it will receive a live ivory heading, a live points coin at centre, and a live small recipient label below. Do not paint any lettering, words, symbols resembling letters, numerals or points values anywhere. Do not paint a central coin, because the app supplies its own live coin. The dark opaque inner panel is essential so this reward stays readable over a busy warm brown wooden tavern table.
Paint matte believable materials with broad value groups and selective detail: cool slate and blue-gray shadows, warm ivory at the small card crest, muted aged brass around the silhouette. Grounded painterly medieval game UI prop, finely crafted but readable at small size. Neutral light, crisp silhouette, no global amber wash. No neon, no bloom, no floating particles, no dramatic flames, no background scenery, no table or room, no mockup, no screenshot, no multiple variants, no checkerboard painted into the image. Keep the centre flat and unadorned for text. This is a standalone production-ratio prop, not a full game screen.
refinements:
Edit image 1, the draft clean-table reward plaque, to match Fall's ACTUAL existing UI artwork instead of introducing a different metallic style.
Reference roles: image 2 is the shipped brass-frame.webp and is the authoritative border color, finish and ornament reference. Image 3 is the shipped seat-plaque.webp, authoritative for its restrained slim border profile and dark inset. Image 4 is the shipped primary.webp action plate, authoritative for shallow bevels and controlled edge highlights. These references are materials/style references only: do not add the red button face.
Preserve a standalone 3:2 landscape reward plaque with an ample blank charcoal interior and a small three-blank-card crest at the top centre. Keep all writing areas blank: the app will supply live ivory title, points badge and recipient; no lettering, no numerals and no central coin.
Correct the frame substantially: use the same darker warm brown bronze and aged brass as the references, with narrow muted honey/ochre highlights only along fine raised edges, deep brown recesses and a subtle reddish-brown undertone in the bevel. Match the reference brass's visual color directly. Make the frame notably slimmer, using finely stepped concentric rails and delicate shallow corner leaf engraving consistent with image 2. Remove the first draft's broad pale yellow gold slabs, coarse hammered/pitted gold texture, chunky rivets, oversized corner masses and bright gold foil appearance. Keep highlights restrained and directional; the midtones should read like the reference brown antique brass, not yellow jewelry gold. Reduce the crest frame bulk and use that same bronze. Keep the tiny blank cards warm muted ivory.
The goal is one native-looking sibling of the existing Fall nameplates, buttons and framed surfaces. Retain the dark, quiet interior for strong readable contrast over the wooden game table, but use near-neutral charcoal rather than conspicuous blue slate. Original painterly medieval UI, matte materials, shallow detail. No glow, no bloom, no yellow haze, no golden background or scene.
Output only the isolated revised plaque on a genuinely transparent alpha exterior, with clean anti-aliased silhouette and at most a tight neutral shadow hugging the edge. Remove the broad warm mist around the original draft. Keep the intended 1536 x 1024 aspect and resolution, with small transparent margins. No extra variants or game screenshot.
